reply.text:
I'm glad you said it out loud, because the fear is what I'd focus on here. Being scared of a whole food group and cutting it out completely is one to talk through with a doctor or a registered dietitian. They can help with the eating side in a way a coach can't. I'm not going to build workouts around a no-carb plan, because training hard on that is not something I want to set you up for.

Once you've had that conversation, I'd be glad to build you a program and get you training. What's been going on with food lately?
